## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      3 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 24 янв. 2026 г. - 2 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _tmac66_, 2 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "Filled with bugs and glitches this app needs a lot of work. I get the feeling this thing was thrown together overnight. If you’re a beginner be very careful because this app does not guide you as it should. It doesn’t ask if you have any medical issues such as rotator cuff bad back or any following type of injuries that would potentially prevent you from doing certain exercises. I have found that it adds sets. I had one exercise were it had me doing it 10 times."
            2. _mo4958589594_, 24 янв. 2026 г., 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"
            3. _East County Mom_, 23 сент. 2026 г., 3/5: "App glitches more often than not. Workouts don’t always feel like they flow well together."
